work.summary: Physical photobook created through the ROTTA × ZENNY collaboration and featuring Korean model and online creator Shin Jae-eun (신재은, Zenny). Her official site identifies her aliases and lists Aqua under photo books; YES24 and Aladin bibliographic records agree on ISBN 9791188073146, release date 2018-01-26, and 168 pages. Retailer weight values conflict and are omitted. No asset-specific image reuse permission is documented, so no cover or interior image is copied or hosted.

edition.contentSummary: YES24 and Aladin list a physical Korean photo-book edition with ISBN 9791188073146, published by bravo on 2018-01-26, 168 pages, and dimensions 183 × 257 mm. No cover or interior asset is included because reuse permission was not found.
